entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Rain is expected to turn to snow about the higher parts of the road late Wednesday morning. 1 to 2 cm may accumulate near the summit of the road with lesser amounts down to 800 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Snow Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy snow above 800 metres, where snowfall amounts may approach warning criteria. Note, lesser amounts of snow could fall as low as 400 metres. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate. Changes: The chance of upgrade for this Watch has been decreased to Moderate and timing for onset of heavy snow delayed.

entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy rain. Rainfall amounts may approach warning criteria, especially about the ranges. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate. Changes: Watch period reduced.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 300 to 450 mm of rain about the ranges, and 150 to 200 mm nearer the coast. Peak rates of 20 to 30 mm/h expected Wednesday afternoon and evening, then again from Thursday afternoon to Friday morning about the ranges. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Low.
